methods.name: Tetrahedral orientation-local-system checker
capabilities: enumerate the 24 signed-permutation symmetries of the regular tetrahedral normal family
verify determinant equals induced S4 permutation sign
compute the six FCC [110]-type shared line families
verify the cross-operator square identity on every slice
verify twisted covariance Q D_n Q^-1 = det(Q) D_(Qn)
count A4 and odd transports between each ordered slice pair
enumerate triangle-loop frame holonomy and prove C2 chirality flatness
separate incidence-ray reversal from complex-structure reversal
compare the ambient orientation class with the eight abstract H1(K4,F2) sign classes
methods.exactness: integer matrices and finite exhaustive enumeration; no floating point, angle, trigonometry, or numerical pi
boundaries: does not prove global P000 six-dimensional trajectory factorization
does not identify J with a primitive native spatial axis
does not identify this orientation character with tetrahedral residual torsion or Pell shell sign
